title: Narvacan holds bagnet boodle fight to promote local product

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — Local government officials and employees of Narvacan, along with representatives from the Department of Tourism and other guests, joined a Bagnet Boodle Fight as part of the town’s Bagnet Festival on Sunday, Sept. 27. The boodle fight featured bagnet, chicharon, paksiw na okra, tomatoes and bagoong. Members of the Philippine National Police and Bureau of Fire Protection also joined the communal feast. READ: Narvacan, Ilocos Sur stages inaugural Bagnet Festival Mayor Edna Cabalo Sanidad said the annual Bagnet Festival would help promote Narvacan’s local product while showcasing the town’s culture and community spirit.
